source_modes.new_for_release: no source adjustment irrespective of who writes the newly commissioned words/music
source_modes.mixed: requires music-level source audit; choose mild preset only with documented substantial inherited material
source_modes.existing_work_cover: standard preset is candidate subject to actual adaptation and genre double-count screening
source_modes.traditional: genre embedded tradition must be screened; often use no or reduced source adjustment
source_modes.self_re_recording: authorship remains original artist but current release reuses earlier composition; use audited adjustment
source_modes.unknown: no approved adjustment; score draft only until source status verified

no_double_count: Do not subtract stars merely because source is not newly authored when a weight shift was applied
If style profile already rewards interpretation of existing repertoire, reduce or omit provenance shift
Selection of culturally historic materials is not itself strong Context evidence
Changes are decided before star ratings, never reverse-engineer desired ranking
Cultural adjustment cannot reuse the same rationale as source adjustment
lyrics_na_rule: Preserve V0.13 culture ordering: apply approved culture vector to the original genre weights, then exclude lyrics and renormalize the remaining dynamic three to 70. Finally apply a separately approved zero-sum source vector among composition/performance/sound only. Never transfer a missing lyrics weight twice.
genre_blend_rule: if genuine cross-family juxtaposition, calculate one album-wide vector from track genre vectors, then apply source adjustment at release level; do not average track stars
publication: source ledger and four-dimension evidence required; experimental source percentages must not be described as empirically verified
cultural_amendment: remains separately evidence gated, 4 p.p. absolute change; combined gross max 16 p.p.
precision: Fraction exact arithmetic; half-up to two decimals only for display
